import numpy as np

def mutual_information(joint_probs):
    p_x = joint_probs.sum(axis=1)
    p_y = joint_probs.sum(axis=0)
    p_independent = np.outer(p_x, p_y)
    mask = joint_probs > 0
    mi = np.sum(joint_probs[mask] * np.log2(joint_probs[mask] / p_independent[mask]))
    return mi

def normalized_mutual_information(joint_probs):
    p_x = joint_probs.sum(axis=1)
    p_y = joint_probs.sum(axis=0)
    p_x_pos = p_x[p_x > 0]
    p_y_pos = p_y[p_y > 0]
    h_x = -np.sum(p_x_pos * np.log2(p_x_pos))
    h_y = -np.sum(p_y_pos * np.log2(p_y_pos))
    mi = mutual_information(joint_probs)
    nmi = mi / np.sqrt(h_x * h_y) if h_x * h_y > 0 else 0
    return nmi

def pointwise_mi(joint_probs):
    p_x = joint_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    p_y = joint_probs.sum(axis=0, keepdims=True)
    p_independent = p_x @ p_y
    pmi = np.where(joint_probs > 0, np.log2(joint_probs / p_independent), 0)
    return pmi

joint = np.array([[0.4, 0.1], [0.1, 0.4]])
print(f"Mutual Information: {mutual_information(joint):.4f} bits")
print(f"Normalized MI: {normalized_mutual_information(joint):.4f}")
